2607.01972.title: Object Aligner: A Configurable JSON Schema Similarity Score for Graphs, Applied to LLM Prompt Optimization
2607.01972.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) are often asked to produce JSON conforming to a fixed schema, powering information extraction, tool calling, agentic planning, and knowledge-graph construction. Measuring how closely an output matches a gold reference is essential yet surprisingly hard: exact match is brittle, text similarity ignores structure, and an LLM judge is expensive, opaque, and non-deterministic. We address this with Object Aligner (OA), an open-source Python library that scores two JSON objects deterministically by recursively aligning their trees (the Hungarian algorithm for unordered collections, sequence alignment for ordered ones) and awarding partial credit at the granularity the schema declares. The Object Aligner is configured entirely through a set of JSON Schema extensions, so adapting it to a new task involves annotating a schema rather than writing code. Complex structured data, however, are rarely flat trees: records may form graphs or hypergraphs keyed by arbitrary identifiers, breaking the assumptions of prior similarity metrics. Our central contribution, referential alignment, closes this gap by inferring a bijection between gold and candidate identifiers and scoring every reference through it, so the score is invariant to relabeling. Since recovering this bijection exactly is graph isomorphism, the Object Aligner approximates it with Weisfeiler-Leman color refinement. An order-sensitive sequence regime targets ranking and planning. Since the same alignment localizes every mismatch, the Object Aligner emits ranked repair suggestions at no extra cost. Used as a reward inside the GEPA prompt optimizer, Object Aligner helps or stays neutral across all datasets.
2607.01972.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）經常被要求生成符合固定架構的 JSON，以支持信息提取、工具調用、代理計劃和知識圖譜構建。衡量輸出與金標準的匹配程度至關重要，但出奇地困難：精確匹配脆弱，文本相似性忽略結構，而 LLM 評估者則昂貴、不透明且非確定性。我們用物件對齊器（Object Aligner, OA）來解決這個問題，這是一個開源的 Python 庫，通過遞歸對齊其樹來確定性地評分兩個 JSON 對象（無序集合的匈牙利算法、有序集合的序列對齊），並在架構所聲明的顆粒度上授予部分分數。物件對齊器完全通過一組 JSON 架構擴展進行配置，因此將其適應新任務涉及註釋架構而不是編寫代碼。然而，複雜的結構化數據很少是平坦的樹：記錄可能形成由任意標識符鍵入的圖或超圖，打破了先前相似性度量的假設。我們的核心貢獻，即參考對齊，通過推斷金標準和候選標識符之間的雙射來填補這一空白，並通過它對每個引用進行評分，因此分數對重新標記是不變的。由於準確恢復這一雙射是圖同構，物件對齊器使用 Weisfeiler-Leman 顏色細化來近似它。一個對順序敏感的序列機制針對排名和規劃。由於相同的對齊定位每一個不匹配，物件對齊器以不額外成本發出排名修復建議。作為 GEPA 提示優化器中的獎勵使用，物件對齊器在所有數據集上提供幫助或保持中立。
